meta.title: 파란 버스
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (「파란 버스」, a summer single by the band 여름잠, as a lyric video (fictional band, song and lyrics)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 「파란 버스」, a summer single by the band 여름잠, as a lyric video (fictional band, song and lyrics)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Sky blue #6EC3F0 to a pale #D3F0FF, the sea #2F8FD8, a blue bus #2E6BE6 with a white band, a yellow sun #FFD84D, pines #2F7D4A, sand and a grey road; lyrics white with a navy outline #173A7A, filled yellow #FFE15C as they are sung.
rationale.type: Jua, round and friendly, for the lyrics and the title; Gowun Dodum for the band name and the small print.
rationale.motion: The words are the motion: every syllable pops (a springy scale and lift) and turns yellow on the note that sings it, the next line waits small below; the bus bounces on every beat with the band bobbing in its windows, jumps every second beat in the chorus under confetti; a window slides open and the curtain catches the wind; the route map runs the bus to the last stop.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 112 BPM in A major (pad, pluck, bass, kick, clap, hats, shaker) with no lead, because the lead is the voice: the engine sings every syllable from its own cue with a formant voice (a Hangul syllable split into consonant, vowel and final; the vowel lands on the beat, the consonant leads in); a bell for the bus stop.
rationale.visuals: All code: flat summer illustration with parallax (clouds, sea sparkles, pines, road marks), a bus drawn from rounded rectangles, a window view clipped to the frame, a dotted route on a top-down coast; the lyric layout reads the sing cues, so the letters and the voice share one list.
rationale.narration: Not applicable: the reel is sung.
